The [callTracer standardization PR](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/855) is in last call. With 4 clients at 100% pass rate for the pre-Amsterdam tests (reth has 2 open PRs to fix). If there's no objections it'll get merged after the next RPC standards call on Monday. It was modified to test only blocks before Amsterdam to keep things clean.

Post-Amsterdam work and tests will continue in [852](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/852)
